response.query: What objective verification methods (immunization registry, clinic confirmations, biomarkers, admin data linkages) are feasible for HPV and other behaviors within our rural contexts?
response.answer: Objective verification methods for HPV include immunization registries, clinic confirmations, biomarkers, and administrative data linkages. HPV vaccination records and biomarker tests are feasible in rural contexts. Clinic confirmations and administrative data are reliable for behavior tracking.

results.content: Human papillomavirus (HPV)-positive (HPV+) oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC) has one of the most rapidly increasing incidences of any cancer in high-income countries.
